localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description: Tucked into a small, wooded area just off Mount Seymour Road, this campground has 1 shelter, 7 picnic tables (6 indoor and 1 outdoor) and a fire pit. The campsite is 100 x 30 feet with a capacity for about 12 tents. The shelter has a wood stove for use in winter. There is an external water tap (closed November to mid-May) and a pit toilet located within the reservation area. Winter reservations are advised to come prepared with their own water supply. There are no parking spaces directly at the site, but there is free parking approximately 100m away at Parking lot P1.
